If sentiment is >0.67 in the last 3 days, increase forecast by 0.5–1.5% for early horizon (1–7 days) to capture bullish momentum.

If sentiment is <0.33 in the last 3 days, reduce forecast by 0.5–1.5% for early horizon (1–7 days) to hedge downside risk.

If sentiment is >0.67 and forecast is rising, add 1–2% to mid-horizon (8–15 days) to reinforce upward bias.

If sentiment is <0.33 and forecast is falling, subtract 1–2% from mid-horizon (8–15 days) to dampen overcorrection.

If sentiment is >0.67 and true outcome exceeds forecast by >2%, apply 1–3% upward adjustment to late horizon (16–30 days) to reflect sustained momentum.

If sentiment is <0.33 and true outcome is below forecast by >2%, apply 1–3% downward adjustment to late horizon (16–30 days) to avoid overhang.
